method: Estimate harmonic rhythm from recurring accompaniment changes, classify texture in each span (bass, power chord, block chord, strummed chord, arpeggiated chord or mixed), then estimate harmony with texture-dependent melody weights. Bass-only spans can establish a degree without a complete triad; reviewed chord-presence constraints and saved annotations take precedence. Unresolved spans use twice the estimated harmonic period, capped at eight beats. Not a definitive harmonic transcription.
